_comment: VERIFY every model id against the provider's current docs before a real run. Ids move; a stale id silently drops a panellist from the ledger. Run `npm run cairn:panel -- check` first: it calls each configured member with a trivial prompt and reports which ids actually resolve. `label` is the stable identity in the ledger - keep it constant across runs even if the underlying model id changes.
_maxTokensNote: Not a lowball. Reasoning models spend this same budget on thinking before emitting any visible text - claude-opus-5 runs adaptive thinking by default - so a small cap yields an empty response and an unparseable-forecast error that looks like flakiness. 1200 was the old value and would have starved the two strongest members on every call.
